topics.title: Place value
topics.summary: You can read, write and compare large whole numbers by the value of each digit.

topics.title: Multi-digit addition and subtraction
topics.summary: You can add and subtract multi-digit numbers accurately, with or without regrouping.

topics.title: Multiplication facts
topics.summary: You can recall every multiplication fact through twelve instantly.

topics.title: Multi-digit multiplication
topics.summary: You can multiply multi-digit numbers using the standard method.

topics.title: Long division
topics.summary: You can divide multi-digit numbers by long division and check the result.

topics.title: What a remainder means
topics.summary: You can interpret a remainder as a leftover amount, a fraction or a rounded answer depending on the question.

topics.title: Factors and multiples
topics.summary: You can find all the factors of a number and list its multiples.

topics.title: Primes and factor trees
topics.summary: You can tell a prime from a composite number and break any number into its prime factors.

topics.title: Order of operations
topics.summary: You can evaluate a mixed calculation in the correct order every time.

topics.title: What a fraction means
topics.summary: You can explain a fraction as a division and as a part of a whole.

topics.title: Equivalent fractions
topics.summary: You can build and recognise equivalent fractions.

topics.title: Comparing fractions
topics.summary: You can order fractions with different denominators from smallest to largest.

topics.title: Adding and subtracting fractions
topics.summary: You can add and subtract fractions with different denominators.

topics.title: Multiplying fractions
topics.summary: You can multiply two fractions and simplify the result.

topics.title: Dividing fractions
topics.summary: You can divide by a fraction by multiplying by its reciprocal.

topics.title: Mixed numbers
topics.summary: You can convert between mixed numbers and improper fractions and calculate with them.

topics.title: Decimal place value
topics.summary: You can read, write and compare decimals by the value of each place.

topics.title: Decimals and fractions
topics.summary: You can convert between a decimal and its equivalent fraction.

topics.title: Adding and subtracting decimals
topics.summary: You can add and subtract decimals by lining up the places.

topics.title: Multiplying and dividing decimals
topics.summary: You can multiply and divide decimals and place the decimal point correctly.

topics.title: Rounding and estimation
topics.summary: You can round a number to a given place and estimate an answer before calculating.

topics.title: Mental arithmetic
topics.summary: You can add, subtract, multiply and divide small numbers quickly in your head.

topics.title: Units and measurement
topics.summary: You can convert between metric units of length, weight, time and capacity.

topics.title: Multi-step word problems
topics.summary: You can plan and solve a word problem that needs more than one operation.

topics.title: Ratio
topics.summary: You can write a ratio, simplify it and use it to compare two quantities.

topics.title: Rate and unit rate
topics.summary: You can find a unit rate and use it to compare two rates.

topics.title: Percent
topics.summary: You can convert between a percent, a fraction and a decimal and find a percent of a quantity.

topics.title: Percent change
topics.summary: You can find the percent increase or decrease between two amounts.

topics.title: Negative numbers
topics.summary: You can place negative numbers on a number line and compare them.

topics.title: Integer operations
topics.summary: You can add, subtract, multiply and divide positive and negative integers.

topics.title: Rational number operations
topics.summary: You can calculate with positive and negative fractions and decimals.

topics.title: Exponents
topics.summary: You can evaluate an expression with whole-number exponents and apply the basic exponent rules.

topics.title: Square roots
topics.summary: You can find or estimate the square root of a number.

topics.title: The distributive law
topics.summary: You can multiply a bracket out across a sum and combine like terms.

topics.title: Expressions and variables
topics.summary: You can write and simplify an algebraic expression from a description.

topics.title: One-step equations
topics.summary: You can solve a one-step equation for the unknown.

topics.title: Two-step equations
topics.summary: You can solve a two-step equation for the unknown.

topics.title: Inequalities
topics.summary: You can solve and graph a one-step or two-step inequality on a number line.

topics.title: The coordinate plane
topics.summary: You can plot and read points in all four quadrants of the coordinate plane.

topics.title: Proportional relationships and graphs
topics.summary: You can recognise a proportional relationship from its graph, table or equation.

topics.title: Mean, median and spread
topics.summary: You can find the mean, median and spread of a data set and say what each one tells you.

topics.title: Counting basics
topics.summary: You can count outcomes using the multiplication principle and simple permutations.

topics.title: Probability basics
topics.summary: You can find the probability of a simple event as a fraction, decimal or percent.

topics.title: Angles
topics.summary: You can name, measure and find missing angles using the angle rules.

topics.title: Triangles
topics.summary: You can classify a triangle and use its angle sum to find a missing angle.

topics.title: Area and perimeter
topics.summary: You can find the area and perimeter of rectangles, triangles and simple composite shapes.

topics.title: Volume and surface area
topics.summary: You can find the volume and surface area of rectangular prisms and simple solids.

topics.title: The Pythagorean theorem
topics.summary: You can use the Pythagorean theorem to find a missing side of a right triangle.

topics.title: Divisibility rules
topics.summary: You can tell whether a number is divisible by another using a divisibility rule.

topics.title: Greatest common divisor and least common multiple
topics.summary: You can find the greatest common divisor and least common multiple of two numbers.

topics.title: Introduction to modular arithmetic
topics.summary: You can find a remainder under a given modulus and use it to spot a repeating pattern.

topics.title: Counting by cases
topics.summary: You can count a set of outcomes by splitting it into cases and adding them.

topics.title: Complementary counting
topics.summary: You can count the outcomes you want by counting the ones you do not want and subtracting.

topics.title: Introduction to expected value
topics.summary: You can find the expected value of a simple game or bet.

topics.title: Multi-step equations
topics.summary: You can solve an equation with the letter on both sides, brackets or fractions.

topics.title: Literal equations
topics.summary: You can solve a formula for any one of its letters, keeping every step balanced.

topics.title: Modelling with equations
topics.summary: You can turn a situation described in words into an equation and solve it.

topics.title: Slope
topics.summary: You can find the rate of change from two points, a table or a graph.

topics.title: Slope-intercept form
topics.summary: You can read, write and graph a line from its slope and its starting value.

topics.title: Forms of a line
topics.summary: You can convert a line between forms and tell a parallel line from a perpendicular one.

topics.title: Lines from data
topics.summary: You can sketch a line of best fit by eye and say what its slope and start mean.

topics.title: Systems by graphing and substitution
topics.summary: You can solve two linear equations together by graphing them or by substitution.

topics.title: Systems by elimination
topics.summary: You can solve two linear equations together by adding or subtracting them.

topics.title: Modelling with systems
topics.summary: You can set up and solve a system of equations from a situation.

topics.title: Multi-step inequalities
topics.summary: You can solve a multi-step inequality, including a compound one joined by and or or.

topics.title: Inequalities in two variables
topics.summary: You can graph an inequality in two variables as a shaded half of the plane.

topics.title: Absolute value
topics.summary: You can solve an absolute value equation or inequality by thinking about distance from zero.

topics.title: Exponent rules
topics.summary: You can combine powers using the product, quotient, power, zero and negative exponent rules.

topics.title: Scientific notation
topics.summary: You can write a very large or very small number in scientific notation and back.

topics.title: Adding and subtracting polynomials
topics.summary: You can add and subtract polynomials by combining their matching terms.

topics.title: Multiplying polynomials
topics.summary: You can multiply polynomials, including two binomials and a few special products.

topics.title: Factoring by gcf and grouping
topics.summary: You can factor out a shared term or factor a four-term expression by grouping.

topics.title: Factoring trinomials
topics.summary: You can factor a trinomial into two binomials.

topics.title: Special factoring patterns
topics.summary: You can spot and factor a difference of squares or a perfect square trinomial.

topics.title: Quadratics by factoring
topics.summary: You can solve a quadratic equation by factoring it and using the zero product rule.

topics.title: Graphing quadratics
topics.summary: You can graph a parabola from its vertex, axis and intercepts.

topics.title: The quadratic formula
topics.summary: You can solve any quadratic with the quadratic formula or by completing the square.

topics.title: Functions
topics.summary: You can use function notation, evaluate a function and find its domain and range.

topics.title: Radicals
topics.summary: You can simplify, add, multiply and rationalise simple radical expressions.

topics.title: Exponential patterns
topics.summary: You can write and use a doubling, halving or percent growth pattern as repeated multiplying.

topics.title: Integer solutions to equations
topics.summary: You can find whole number solutions to a linear equation in two letters.

topics.title: Linear congruences
topics.summary: You can solve a linear congruence and use it to argue about divisibility.

topics.title: Permutations and combinations
topics.summary: You can count arrangements with permutations and selections with combinations.

topics.title: Independent and dependent events
topics.summary: You can find the chance of independent and dependent events and an expected value with a variable.

topics.title: Points, lines and angles
topics.summary: You can name points, lines and angle pairs, and find a bisected angle or a distance along a line.

topics.title: Conditional statements and proof
topics.summary: You can write a two-column proof from a conditional statement and find a counterexample that breaks a false claim.

topics.title: Parallel lines and transversals
topics.summary: You can name the angle pairs a transversal makes and prove two lines are parallel from one true pair.

topics.title: Triangle angle relationships
topics.summary: You can find a triangle's missing angle from its sum, its exterior angle, or its isosceles equal sides.

topics.title: Triangle congruence
topics.summary: You can pick the congruence test that proves two triangles congruent, and say why a test like SSA fails.

topics.title: Congruence proofs
topics.summary: You can prove two triangles congruent, then use CPCTC to prove a fact about their matching parts.

topics.title: Triangle centers and inequalities
topics.summary: You can find a midsegment or a triangle's centroid, and compare sides with the triangle inequality or angle order.

topics.title: Quadrilaterals
topics.summary: You can name a quadrilateral's properties and test whether a given one is a parallelogram, rhombus or kite.

topics.title: Polygon angle sums
topics.summary: You can find a polygon's interior or exterior angle sum, and each angle of a regular polygon.

topics.title: Similar triangles
topics.summary: You can prove two triangles similar and use the scale factor to find a missing corresponding side.

topics.title: Applications of similarity
topics.summary: You can use similar triangles for indirect measurement and find a perimeter or area ratio from the scale factor.

topics.title: Right triangles
topics.summary: You can find a right triangle's missing side, or the exact sides of a 45-45-90 or 30-60-90 triangle.

topics.title: Trigonometric ratios
topics.summary: You can name sine, cosine and tangent as side ratios and use one to find a missing side.

topics.title: Applications of trigonometry
topics.summary: You can set up an angle of elevation or depression and solve for a distance with a trig ratio.

topics.title: Arcs and chords
topics.summary: You can find a central angle, an arc measure, or a chord's length using the perpendicular from the centre.

topics.title: Inscribed angles and tangents
topics.summary: You can find an inscribed angle from its arc, and an angle made where chords, secants or tangents meet.

topics.title: Circle segment lengths
topics.summary: You can find an unknown segment length using the chord, secant and tangent product rules.

topics.title: Circumference and arc length
topics.summary: You can find a circle's circumference or an arc's length, and leave the answer as a multiple of pi.

topics.title: Area of polygons
topics.summary: You can find the area of a triangle, parallelogram, trapezoid, rhombus, or regular polygon from its apothem.

topics.title: Area of circles and sectors
topics.summary: You can find a circle's area, a sector's or a segment's area, and a shaded region built from several shapes.

topics.title: Surface area
topics.summary: You can find the surface area of a prism, cylinder, pyramid, cone or sphere from its net or formula.

topics.title: Volume
topics.summary: You can find the volume of a prism, cylinder, pyramid, cone or sphere, and use Cavalieri's idea to compare solids.

topics.title: Similar solids
topics.summary: You can find how a solid's surface area or volume scales when its linear scale factor changes.

topics.title: Coordinate geometry
topics.summary: You can find a distance, midpoint or slope from coordinates, and classify a figure by its vertices.

topics.title: Coordinate proofs
topics.summary: You can place a figure on the coordinate plane with convenient coordinates and prove one of its properties.

topics.title: Rigid transformations
topics.summary: You can write the coordinate rule for a translation, reflection or rotation and apply it to a point.

topics.title: Dilations and symmetry
topics.summary: You can dilate a figure by a scale factor, compose two transformations, and find its lines of symmetry.

topics.title: Equations of circles
topics.summary: You can write a circle's centre-radius equation from its graph, and graph a circle from its equation.

topics.title: Lattice points
topics.summary: You can count lattice points on a segment using the gcd, and find a polygon's area with Pick's theorem.

topics.title: Counting figures
topics.summary: You can count a polygon's diagonals, the triangles or regions a figure makes, and see handshakes as segments.

topics.title: Geometric probability
topics.summary: You can find a probability from a length, an area or an angle instead of counting outcomes.

topics.title: Graph transformations
topics.summary: You can shift, stretch, compress or reflect a parent graph and write the new function from the change.

topics.title: Composition and inverse functions
topics.summary: You can compose two functions, find an inverse, and check that a function is one-to-one before inverting it.

topics.title: Vertex form and quadratic modeling
topics.summary: You can complete the square to vertex form and use it to find a quadratic's maximum or minimum.

topics.title: Complex numbers
topics.summary: You can add, multiply and conjugate complex numbers, and solve a quadratic whose roots are not real.

topics.title: Polynomial division
topics.summary: You can divide a polynomial by long or synthetic division and use the remainder and factor theorems.

topics.title: Polynomial graphs
topics.summary: You can sketch a polynomial from its end behavior, its zeros and their multiplicity, and its turning points.

topics.title: Higher degree equations
topics.summary: You can factor a higher degree polynomial, use the rational root theorem, and find a sum or product of roots.

topics.title: Rational expressions
topics.summary: You can simplify, multiply, divide and add rational expressions, including a complex fraction with fractions inside it.

topics.title: Rational functions
topics.summary: You can find the asymptotes and holes of a rational function's graph and solve a rational equation.

topics.title: Radical functions and rational exponents
topics.summary: You can rewrite a rational exponent as a radical, solve a radical equation, and check for extraneous roots.

topics.title: Exponential growth and decay
topics.summary: You can model growth or decay with an exponential function, apply compound interest, and see e as a compounding limit.

topics.title: Logarithms
topics.summary: You can define a logarithm, use its properties, change its base, and evaluate one exactly without a calculator.

topics.title: Exponential and log equations
topics.summary: You can solve an exponential or logarithmic equation with logs and give an exact answer, not a decimal.

topics.title: Systems in three variables
topics.summary: You can solve three equations in three variables by elimination and describe what the solution set looks like.

topics.title: Matrices
topics.summary: You can add, multiply and find the determinant of a matrix, invert a 2 by 2 matrix, and solve a system with it.

topics.title: Vectors
topics.summary: You can add vectors, scale them, find a vector's magnitude, and use the dot product to find the angle between two.

topics.title: Sequences
topics.summary: You can write an arithmetic or geometric sequence explicitly or recursively and find any term in it.

topics.title: Series and sigma notation
topics.summary: You can write a sum in sigma notation and find an arithmetic, geometric or infinite geometric sum, including a telescoping one.

topics.title: Conic sections
topics.summary: You can derive a parabola from its focus and directrix and recognize an ellipse or hyperbola from its equation.

topics.title: The unit circle
topics.summary: You can convert between radians and degrees, find arc length, and give the exact value at each special angle.

topics.title: Sine, cosine and tangent as functions
topics.summary: You can graph sine, cosine or tangent and read off the amplitude, period, phase shift and midline.

topics.title: Trig identities
topics.summary: You can use the Pythagorean, sum, difference and double angle identities to prove that a trig identity is true.

topics.title: Trig equations
topics.summary: You can solve a trig equation on a given interval and give an inverse trig value exactly, without a calculator.

topics.title: Law of sines and cosines
topics.summary: You can solve an oblique triangle with the law of sines or cosines, spot the ambiguous case, and find its area from two sides.

topics.title: Polar and parametric equations
topics.summary: You can convert between polar and rectangular coordinates and eliminate the parameter from a parametric equation.

topics.title: The binomial theorem
topics.summary: You can expand a binomial with Pascal's triangle or the binomial theorem and pull out a single term.

topics.title: Probability distributions
topics.summary: You can find the expected value of a distribution, a binomial probability, and the variance of a simple case.

topics.title: Modular arithmetic, advanced
topics.summary: You can compute a modular power, use Fermat's little theorem, find a modular inverse, and solve a remainder system.

topics.title: Counting, advanced
topics.summary: You can count with stars and bars, apply inclusion-exclusion to overlapping cases, and count arrangements with symmetry removed.

topics.title: Conditional probability
topics.summary: You can find a conditional probability, use Bayes' idea on a simple case, and test two events for independence with numbers.

topics.title: Limits from graphs and tables
topics.summary: You can read a limit from a graph or a table, tell the two one-sided limits apart, and say why a limit fails.

topics.title: Limits by algebra
topics.summary: You can evaluate a limit with the limit laws, by factoring, by rationalizing, or with the squeeze idea.

topics.title: Continuity
topics.summary: You can test continuity at a point, name a kind of discontinuity, and use the intermediate value theorem to find a root.

topics.title: Limits at infinity and asymptotes
topics.summary: You can find a limit at infinity, describe end behavior, and locate horizontal and vertical asymptotes from limits.

topics.title: The derivative from its limit
topics.summary: You can build the difference quotient from a graph's slopes, take its limit, and find a tangent line's slope.

topics.title: Reading the derivative from a graph
topics.summary: You can sketch f prime from f, spot where a derivative fails to exist, and explain why differentiable functions are continuous.

topics.title: The power rule
topics.summary: You can differentiate a polynomial with the power, constant multiple and sum rules, then write its tangent line.

topics.title: Product and quotient rules
topics.summary: You can differentiate a product of two functions with the product rule and a quotient with the quotient rule.

topics.title: The chain rule
topics.summary: You can differentiate a composed function with the chain rule and spot a problem that needs it twice.

topics.title: Derivatives of trig functions
topics.summary: You can differentiate all six trig functions and combine that with the chain rule on a composed expression.

topics.title: Derivatives of exponentials and logs
topics.summary: You can differentiate e to the x, a to the x, ln x and log base a of x.

topics.title: Implicit differentiation
topics.summary: You can differentiate both sides of an implicit curve for dy over dx and find an inverse function's derivative.

topics.title: Related rates
topics.summary: You can chain related rates for a sliding ladder, a filling cone or a growing shadow and solve for the rate asked.

topics.title: Linear approximation
topics.summary: You can use a tangent line to estimate a function's value nearby, find a differential, and bound the error.

topics.title: Extrema and the mean value theorem
topics.summary: You can find critical points, apply the extreme value theorem on a closed interval, and use the mean value theorem.

topics.title: First and second derivative tests
topics.summary: You can use the first derivative to find rise and fall and the second to find concavity and inflection.

topics.title: Curve sketching
topics.summary: You can sketch a function's full graph from f, f prime and f double prime, asymptotes and turning points included.

topics.title: Optimization
topics.summary: You can turn a largest box, shortest fence or cheapest can problem into a function and optimize it with derivatives.

topics.title: Antiderivatives
topics.summary: You can find an indefinite integral with the basic rules and use an initial condition to pin down the constant.

topics.title: Riemann sums
topics.summary: You can approximate an area with left, right and midpoint sums and write the definite integral as their limit.

topics.title: The fundamental theorem of calculus
topics.summary: You can evaluate a definite integral with the fundamental theorem and differentiate an accumulation function built from one.

topics.title: U-substitution
topics.summary: You can integrate with u-substitution on an indefinite integral and adjust the bounds correctly on a definite one.

topics.title: Area between curves
topics.summary: You can set up and evaluate the integral for the area trapped between two curves, choosing the right variable.

topics.title: Motion and accumulation
topics.summary: You can move between position, velocity and acceleration, and find net and total change from a rate in and out.

topics.title: Volumes of revolution
topics.summary: You can find a volume of revolution with discs and washers and see how the shell method covers the same solid.

topics.title: Differential equations, an introduction
topics.summary: You can solve a separable differential equation, model exponential growth or decay, and read a slope field from a picture.

topics.title: Sums, telescoping and the Euclidean algorithm
topics.summary: You can sum powers by telescoping, use floor and divisibility inside a sum, and run the Euclidean algorithm as a recursion.

topics.title: Recursion and counting
topics.summary: You can write a recursion for a count, find its closed form, generate a Fibonacci-style sequence, and prove the count.
